name: Telogica Limited
about: Telogica Limited manufactures and trades in telecommunication products in India. The company provides telecommunication products, including digital and cable fault locators, splicing machines, cable and pipe locators, optical fibre cleaver with auto rotate blades, two port ethernet and data transmission analyzers, network and ADSL testers, SDH analyzers, BER testers, and cable and antenna analyzers, as well as copper testers, optical and data testers, and RF test instruments. It also offers defense products, such as RF components and instruments, optical instruments, microwave subsystems, optical and other instruments. In addition, the company provides manufacturing products comprising amplifiers, rack mount and solid state power amplifiers, fiber optic temperature sensors, optical laser sources, XDSL testers, visual fault locators, power meters, passive electronic marker location systems, optical variable attenuators and loss testers, optical light sources and fibre identifiers, optical connector inspectors and power meters, optical talk sets, data circuit testers, electronic route markers, ATL trace marks, patch cords, band up and down converters, RF power meters, handheld optical multimeter and laser source, as well as engages in the development of seed laser diode pump assembly. Further, it trades in spectrum, vector network, and site analyzers; and signal generators, BTS testers, cable route locators, electronic markets, and locating systems. The company exports its products and services. It serves the telecommunications, research, defense, commercial, industrial, military, navy, space, and public sectors. The company was formerly known as Aishwarya Technologies and Telecom Limited and changed its name to Telogica Limited in October 2023. Telogica Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.
